description_expanded: OverviewINLET BEACH – Stepping Stone Main & Carriage House Luxurious Coastal Retreat | Steps from Rosemary Beach | Private Pool | Sleeps 14 DESCRIPTION Welcome to “Stepping Stone Home”, your ideal beach escape in Inlet Beach. Perfectly positioned just steps from 30A and Rosemary Beach, this stunning coastal retreat offers ample space, luxurious design, and flexibility for your entire group. Recently renovated with $450k in upgrades and improvements, including a brand-new private elevator, this property combines comfort, style, and convenience for a memorable beach vacation. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Unwind in your own private oasis—featuring a serene pool and sun-drenched courtyard perfect for lounging, grilling, and dining al fresco with friends and family. Your stay includes beach chairs, umbrellas, and six adult bikes, making it easy to explore the shoreline and nearby attractions. Whether you're soaking up the sun or cruising the coast, everything you need for a relaxing getaway is right here. MAIN HOUSE FEATURES 4 bedrooms | 4 full + 1 half bathrooms | Sleeps 12 Three king suites with private en-suites Bunk room with twin-over-twin bunks and pull-out trundles (sleeps 6) Two primary suites, each with soaking tubs, showers, views, and peaceful retreat space Two outdoor courtyards and a private pool (heated for an additional fee) Open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area with high-end appliances Refreshment station with coffee maker and mini fridge on the top floor New XBox Series X with two controllers CARRIAGE HOUSE FEATURES 1 bedroom | 1 bathroom | Sleeps 2 Fully equipped kitchen and comfortable living area ALL OPTIONS INCLUDE New extra-large Samsung Smart TVs Hi-speed WiFi internet New beach chairs, bikes, and umbrellas New AC/heat systems Whole-house 6-stage water purification system Off-street parking for up to 4 vehicles DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Steps to Rosemary Beach, Inlet Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach Explore local shops, dining, and attractions along 30A Close to beach access WHY STAY HERE? Ideal for large groups, families, or multiple families seeking flexibility and privacy Luxurious accommodations with ample space to relax and unwind Prime location with everything, including dining, shopping, and beautiful beaches Stepping Stone Main & Carriage House offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Whether you're gathering in the main house or enjoying the cozy carriage house, your stay on 30A will be nothing short of spectacular.Show less
